text:
A glass beaker contains a mass of 0.20kg of water at a temperature of 20°C.
The specific heat capacity of water is 4200J/(kg°C).
A brass block of mass 0.15kg is at a temperature of 170°C. The block is carefully lowered into
the beaker of water.
The final temperature of both the water and brass is 30°C.
What is the specific heat capacity of the brass?
(Assume that no water is lost and no thermal energy has been transferred to the beaker or the
surroundings.)
A
400J/(kg°C)
B
660J/(kg°C)
C
1200J/(kg°C)
D
5600J/(kg°C)
subject: Physics
